title: NASA Saturn satellite sheet: Mimas (I) mass 0.379×10^20 kg, radius 208 x 197 x 191 km
summary: The Saturn satellite fact sheet lists Mimas (I) at mass 0.379 × 10^20 kg and radius 208 x 197 x 191 km.
body: NASA's Saturn satellite fact sheet lists Mimas (I) with mass 0.379 × 10^20 kg, radius 208 x 197 x 191 km, mean density 1150 kg/m^3, and visual geometric albedo 0.6. Orbital parameters on the same sheet: Semi-major axis (10 3 km) = 185.52; Semi-major axis (Saturnian Radii) = 3.0783; Orbital Period* (days) = 0.9424218; Rotation Period (days) = S; Inclination (degrees) = 1.53; Eccentricity = 0.0202. These are the cells printed on the sheet. The sheet does not say, on this row, which cells are a spacecraft measurement and which are an estimate. The sheet says R indicates retrograde motion, and S indicates synchronous rotation, the rotation period equal to the orbital period. Author of the sheet: Dr. David R. Williams, NASA Goddard Space Flight Center. Last Updated line: 22 July 2025.
